verdict.rationale: Jira is a work-tracking and project-management product, not a coding agent or execution environment, so having an agent detect and install toolchains is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Jira itself runs code or installs dependencies. Its Rovo AI features cover task breakdown, automation and trend analysis, and its sandboxes are replicas of a Jira site rather than code environments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have a coding agent auto-detect and install the toolchains and dependencies it needs for a task
